about.metadataDescription: Meet rvbtech, a plumbing and electrical contracting company in Nepal. Discover the founder's field experience and the belief in better advice, careful work, and lasting accountability.
about.heroHeading: A company you can come back to.
about.lead: Good work should come with clear advice and someone to turn to afterwards.
about.intro: We’re a plumbing and electrical contracting company in Nepal, shaped by our founder’s {years} years of hands-on field experience and a desire for a more thoughtful way of working.
about.storyDescription: The idea for rvbtech grew from lessons in the field: the work itself, the conversations around it, and what happens after handover.

chapters.title: Learning through the work
chapters.description: Hands-on work teaches lessons a finished room cannot show. Pipe routes, connections, material choices, and the use of a small space all matter. Over years in the field, our founder learned to look beyond the visible result and consider how each decision affects the whole installation.

chapters.title: Seeing beyond the immediate fix
chapters.description: A tap can run and a light can turn on while important questions remain unanswered. Was the layout considered? Were the materials suitable? What will future maintenance involve? Those questions shaped a belief that good work should be judged by more than whether it functions on the day it is finished.

chapters.title: Making room for better advice
chapters.description: Clients deserve a clear explanation of their options before installation begins. An inspiring reference image is a starting point; the available space, budget, materials, and practical limits determine what can be achieved. Better conversations help everyone understand the intended result and the choices behind it.

chapters.title: Creating a company to return to
chapters.description: Work often begins with a personal recommendation: someone knows a plumber or an electrician. But finding that same person again can be difficult. The idea behind rvbtech was to create a recognizable company that clients could contact again, with a shared understanding of the work and the relationship behind it.

chapters.title: Looking further ahead
chapters.description: That idea continues to shape our direction. We want to bring careful workmanship together with clearer advice, agreed expectations, and better project records. The ambition is a lasting company built around responsibility, with future assistance discussed under clear, agreed conditions.

about.qualityHeading: A working connection is only the beginning.
about.qualityIntro: Material selection, space, layout, workmanship, and access for maintenance all shape an installation. We believe clients deserve to understand those decisions.
about.simpleResult: The tap runs. The light turns on. The immediate need is met.
qualityQuestions: Is the layout right for the available space?
Are the proposed materials suitable for the work?
Has access for future maintenance been considered?
Are the scope, cost, and expected finish understood?
about.qualityTradeoffs: Price alone does not explain quality. A suitable solution depends on the space, scope, materials, and work involved. Clear advice helps clients understand the trade-offs and decide what matters for their project.
about.consultationDescription: Understanding the work together, before it becomes part of the building.

consultationSteps.title: Understand the space
consultationSteps.description: Start with the building, how it will be used, and what the client needs. Small details and practical limits belong in the first conversation.

consultationSteps.title: Explain the options
consultationSteps.description: Discuss materials, layout, finish, and budget together. A useful recommendation makes the trade-offs understandable.

consultationSteps.title: Agree the scope
consultationSteps.description: Build a shared understanding of the proposed work, what is included, and the intended result before installation begins.

consultationSteps.title: Keep changes clear
consultationSteps.description: When requirements change, the revised work and its effect on cost should be discussed, recorded, and agreed rather than assumed.

about.visionHeading: Raising expectations for the work behind the walls.
about.visionParagraph1: We want to help people value the advice, planning, and craftsmanship that make a difference long before a room is finished.
about.visionParagraph2: Our aim is to build a company known for explaining its recommendations, taking care with the work, and giving clients a clear understanding of what comes next. That is the responsibility we want rvbtech to stand for.
